sentences.en: They also carry a wide selection of babydolls, bustiers, corsets, teddys and sexy sets.

sentences.en: They also carry a variety of fantasy costumes, corsets, bustiers, chemises and have a special section for purple lovers.

sentences.en: Evening bustiers are elegant, sexy and fun.

sentences.en: Use the detachable garters that are on most bustiers and attach a pair of nylon stockings for a sensual, feminine feeling.

sentences.en: Many bustiers made for the evening can also be worn as a sexy top with your favorite skirt or pants.

sentences.en: Luxurious sleek satin, delicate lace and luscious leather are just a few of the exquisite, sensual materials used in evening bustiers.

sentences.en: The following styles are several of the beautiful bustiers available from Plus Size Plum.

sentences.en: Some longline bras are also referred to as bustiers as the two types of lingerie are similar in appearance.

sentences.en: However, while some bustiers are dressy and embellished enough to be worn as club attire, perhaps peeking out from beneath a jacket, longline bras look like bras, made to be worn under your clothing.
sentences.vi: Tuy nhiên, trong khi một số người mặc quần áo ăn mặc sang trọng và đủ chỉnh tề để mặc như trang phục câu lạc bộ, có lẽ lấp ló từ bên dưới áo khoác, những chiếc áo lót dài trông giống như áo lót, được tạo ra để mặc bên dưới quần áo của bạn.
